packet.title: Node constructors in the evaluator (implementation) — Early

body.p: After . Owns src/evaluator_construct.c, tests/evaluator_construct_test.c. The seven constructor kinds and SHALLOW_COPY over hand-built IR (as tests/evaluator_test.c does): a new arena tree per constructed node ( builder), content sequences (XQuery 4.0 "Content": adjacent text merged, attributes after children XQTY0024, document nodes unwrapped, XQDY0025 duplicate attributes), copy-namespaces preserve/inherit, construction strip (untyped annotations), namespace nodes (XQDY0101, XQDY0102), base URI and xml:base, the names of computed constructors (XQDY0074, XQDY0044, XQDY0064). Done when every constructor and copy rule has a unit case with allocation-failure loops. Spec: XQuery 4.0 "Node Constructors"; XSLT 4.0 "Constructing Complex Content". Done 2026-10-17 (): src/evaluator_construct.c, 62 IR cases in tests/evaluator_construct_test.c, each also under an allocation-failure loop; IR modes and adders proposed for 3.9 (, "Proposed").
